articleTitle: Graphene THz ultra wideband CPW-fed monopole antenna
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: A terahertz coplanar waveguide fed planar circular monopole antenna with ultra wideband using graphene is proposed and simulated. It reveals that graphene is a very promising material for terahertz antennas. Compared with previously initial work in graphene antennas by V.P. Gusynin et al. , the proposed graphene monopole antenna has better performance in the bandwidth below -10 dB.

articleTitle: Broadband wireless access in an energy efficient environment
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: building heat energy efficiency efforts have lead to the introduction of transparent conductors in double/triple glazing; also foil back insulation in wall cavities and in roof; prevents radioactive loss (gain in hot countries) of heat energy; wireless propagation; and front/back doors are the final opes for wireless.

articleTitle: Radio on visible light (RoVL) — Indoor mobile telephony through visible light channels
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This slide presentation intends to answer the problems faced by the RF technology, by exercising visible light systems for mobile signal transmission in an indoor environment. It put forth the objective that with the adoption of frequency translation, in combination with simple communication entities, the proposed enterprise can be traversed in cellular application. A key characteristic contribution is the inception of radio on visible light communication system, bearing the potential to bestow connectivity to indoor cell phone users in RF restricted or poor signal connectivity areas.

articleTitle: A discrete random variable for raindrop wave propagation modelling
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This presentation describes a technique for generating a discrete random variable (DRV) for raindrop diameter when using a raindrop geometry model that is not continuous in nature. This can be applied to high-frequency canonical problems such as satellite dish simulations, where modelling precipitation at the particulate level enhances the accuracy of the obtained results.

articleTitle: GPR landmine detection and identification using the Hidden Markov model: (Early Stage Results)
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. Some of the specific areas/topics discussed include: UWB ground penetrating radar; S-parameters; clutter; hidden Markov model; GPR waveform design; GPR data acquisition; GPR system set-up; bi-static measurement set-up; and image registration.

articleTitle: Photonic transmitters with rectangular waveguide output for E-Band radio-over-fibre communication systems
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This article presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: photonic transmitter for E-band Radio-over-Fibre applications featuring a RW (ad hoc GCPW to RW transition); improved GCPW to RW transition featuring a fully planar bias tee; and hybrid integration of MMIC amplifiers.

articleTitle: Substrate integrated waveguide technology for the development of 60 GHz photonic transmitters
publicationTitle: 1st IET Colloquium on Antennas, Wireless and Electromagnetics
abstract: This presentation discusses the development of a 60 GHz photonic transmitter for indoor radio-over-fiber (RoF) applications, based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology implemented on high-frequency laminates.
